title: Leaders League recognizes Burford's legal finance expertise in the US, UK and Europe
summary: We are proud to announce that Leaders League has listed Burford Capital in the "leading" tier for legal finance for arbitration in the US and UK, as well as for litigation in the US. Learn more.
body_markdown:
We are proud to announce that Leaders League has recognized Burford Capital in the "leading" tier for arbitration finance in the US and UK, as well as for litigation finance in the US.


Additionally, our litigation finance presence in the UK and Europe has been ranked in the "excellent" tier.


Burford's[Christopher Bogar](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/christopher-bogart/)t ,[Jonathan Molot](https://www.burfordcapital.com/team/people/jonathan-molot/) ,[Aviva Will](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/aviva-will/) ,[Jörn Eschment](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/joern-eschment/)


and[Jeffery Commission](https://www.burfordcapital.com/team/_people-container/jeffery-commission/)


are all individually recognized.


The full rankings can be viewed here for the US ([litigation](https://www.leadersleague.com/en/rankings/dispute-resolution-litigation-litigation-funders-united-states-2025) and[arbitration](https://www.leadersleague.com/en/rankings/dispute-resolution-arbitration-litigation-funders-united-states-2025) ), UK ([litigation](https://www.leadersleague.com/en/rankings/dispute-resolution-litigation-litigation-funders-united-kingdom-2025) and[arbitration](https://www.leadersleague.com/en/rankings/dispute-resolution-arbitration-litigation-funders-united-kingdom-2025) ) and[Europe](https://www.leadersleague.com/en/rankings/europe-best-litigation-funders-2025) .
